---
title: "Welcome to the IPU Lab"
date: 2026-09-29
description: "The Interpersonal Perception & Understanding Lab is now open at Bilkent University."
---

The Interpersonal Perception & Understanding (IPU) Lab has launched in the Department of Psychology at Bilkent University. We study how people see and understand one another, and how screens and AI are changing that.

Take a look at our [research](../research.qmd), and stay tuned for updates.
